AdaptiveAffineOpaque is now implemented in native provider paths, retaining the four-child fallback. Each face tries cyclic colour anchors for an unclamped affine fourth texel; original positions/normals stay shared per chunk, only fallback faces append edge midpoints. Anchor changes update UVs/texels; split/collapse creates a complete replacement before swapping the scene. Original face/barycentric picks survive updates. Actual face budget is checked before native allocation, and a failed colour-triggered replacement leaves the previous view and pick plan intact.

Exact current8nativefiles, candidate patch, source hashes, commands/tests/renderer JAR-input hashes/screenshots and run classification retained in consumer /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/brain-display/adaptive-22. Tests38JavaFX +128JVM +128JS pass with exact Intaglio55658abf override; no new source warning. 3300explicit native picks after topology/anchor changes pass on FX21.0.5 and patched24.0.1, no Stage. Six adaptive regressions include the independently sampled diagonal edge, cyclic/saturated colors, mixed chunk mapping/winding, resource rejection, shared vertices and morphs.

Dense exact beta unlit cortex with asserted24.0.1ES2 no-mip/centroid module origins actually renders549018faces/274513positionvertices,37.70MiB mesh buffers,33.62MiB atlas; guarded2GiB run1190.67MiB peakRSS. Inversion changes framebuffer and restoration returns exact original pixels. Full4child reference2GiB run exhausted Java heap in Prism and returned black despite zero process exit; those timings rejected. Guarded4GiB rerun passes2196072faces/3294108positions,201.06MiB mesh buffers,3437.27MiB peakRSS. A face-only4million default is not a deployment heap guarantee; qualify Prism extra allocation policy before adoption. Pairwise native affine encoding RMS1.800/max44 including edges is an agreement diagnostic, not analytic GPU color certification.

No native commit, consumer pin or installed runtime adoption. Remains: MSAA-aware GPU edge/interior oracle, atlas-packing permutation, actual ray picks, lit/FIR/threshold/palette/device/obliquity coverage, runtime resource budgets and packaging.
